title: SMOK M-Coil Mesh - 5 Pack
description: The Smok M Coils are a testament to Smok's commitment to quality and innovation in the vaping industry. These coils are part of the acclaimed M-Coil series, known for their advanced mesh wire construction that ensures even heating and maximum flavour extraction. Each coil in this series is designed to provide a consistently pure and flavourful vaping experience, enhancing each puff with rich taste and ample vapour. Available in a pack of five, the Smok M Coils offer a range of resistance options to suit your vaping style: 0.4ohm mesh (19 - 22W): DTL . Ideal for those who enjoy a balance of flavour and vapour production. 0.6ohm mesh (15 - 18W): RDTL . Perfect for vapers seeking a moderate throat hit and excellent flavour. 0.8ohm mesh (11 - 14W): MTL . Best suited for a smooth and subtle vaping experience with a focus on flavour. Compatible with the Smok TECH247 Pods, these coils are designed for easy installation and hassle-free use, ensuring that your vaping sessions are as enjoyable as they are effortless. Whether you're a cloud chaser or a flavour enthusiast, the Smok M Coils provide the versatility and performance you need to tailor your vape to your exact preferences. Please note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming’ simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
